name: Tracer
bio: A former test pilot who can manipulate her personal chronal flow, blinking through space and rewinding her recent past.

kit.name: Pulse Pistols
kit.description: Dual-wielded automatic pistols effective at close range.

kit.name: Blink
kit.description: Teleport a short distance in the direction Tracer is moving.

kit.name: Recall
kit.description: Rewind several seconds, returning to a prior position, health, and ammo state.

kit.name: Pulse Bomb
kit.description: Throw an adhesive bomb that detonates after a short delay, dealing heavy area damage.
